values.title: Amihan Garden
values.story: An invented botanical composition with airy stems and loose lilac brushwork on a light canvas. Created as an AI textile concept for this demonstration collection.

values.title: Dapithapon
values.story: An invented floral composition with warm rose and coral forms against ivory. Created as an AI textile concept, with no founder-provided memory or source painting claimed.

values.title: Luntian
values.story: An invented botanical rhythm of green leaves and light lavender accents. Generated for the sample collection rather than attributed to a physical painting.

values.title: Hiraya Bloom
values.story: An invented airy blue floral print with generous light space. Generated as a textile direction for the sample halter dress.

values.title: Sinag Field
values.story: An invented meadow-like print with soft flowers and warm light. Generated as the artwork source for the sample wrap dress.
